'''watch your ste... o well. Bring him before me NOW!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[watch your ste... o well.]]
* '''Published:''' 26 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM well. DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

fun to play deck thast works (most of the time)if you have any ideas please share them thanks!

== Strategy ==

set up with the emperor, pull vader with holonet transmission (I havent had a game yet in which vader or holonet transmission was not in my opening hand),win a couple battles, capture luke and turn him.
